before.flow: Immediate native placement through the original weapon mount path

measurementConditions.knownConcurrentActivity: Another UI browser verification of interior placement overlapped part of this run, as reported by the parent agent during measurement. Other OS/container scheduling is not controlled.
measurementConditions.timingClaim: This is an observation of actual input acceptance and camera movement while actual Worker calculations are pending. It is not a controlled before/after speed comparison or FPS acceptance result.

after.flow: native tap, strict Worker candidate validation, native confirm

completion.knownIssue: During initial large-design preparation, the fast authoring caches are ready but the semantic surface proxy is absent. Even after native arming and two real RAFs, a visible canvas witness has no strict pick target. The first tap is rejected before a fitting candidate reaches the Worker. This does not establish failure after the full surface proxy is ready.
completion.cameraScope: The camera gesture ran while the real background geometry/statistics request was pending; it did not run during a successfully submitted fitting candidate calculation.

interpretation: The after scenario is ERROR, not a completed placement or performance acceptance test.
Both real camera gestures changed the camera while real background Worker results were pending.
Before uses immediate tap commits; after requires Worker validation and native confirmation, and stops before the first candidate.
Canvas dimensions differ, and another UI browser overlapped part of before. No comparable speed improvement is claimed.
JS heap values are browser-exposed estimates at the recorded stages. No after-run heap sample, total worker/process/GPU memory, leak rate or memory improvement is claimed.
Headless Chromium/SwiftShader only; Safari and physical iPhone hardware are unverified.
